chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from the one who mentioned it, from Al-Husayn ibn Bashr, who said:

I asked Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about a man who has a slave girl, and she has a daughter, and he has sexual relations with her. Is it permissible for him to have sexual relations with her daughter? He (peace be upon him) said: 'Would the righteous man marry his own daughter?'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Reza (peace be upon him), the 8th Imam
key_terms.يَقَعُ عَلَيْهَا: He has sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to have relations with a slave girl and her daughter simultaneously?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) employs a rhetorical analogy to clarify the ruling of *Jam' al-Shata'in* (simultaneous possession) for slave girls. By asking if a righteous man would marry his own daughter, he highlights the prohibition of consanguinity to imply that the prohibition of 'two sisters' does not extend to a mother and daughter who are both concubines, as they are not sisters in the marital sense. This establishes the permissibility for a man to have sexual relations with both a slave girl and her daughter simultaneously, distinguishing it from the prohibition of marrying two sisters at once.
